name: Cycode
description: Cycode application security posture management and code security

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Cycode
2. Go to Settings → API Tokens
3. Generate a new API token — Cycode will display a Client ID and a Secret
4. Copy both values and paste them below
5. The token must belong to a role with read access to Projects and Violations

credentialFields.label: Client ID
credentialFields.helpText: Cycode → Settings → API Tokens → Generate Token (copy the Client ID).

credentialFields.label: Client Secret
credentialFields.helpText: Cycode → Settings → API Tokens → Generate Token (copy the Secret shown alongside the Client ID).
